Maya Chen: Heads-up — observed p95 latency up ~400ms (baseline ~220ms -> 620ms) and throughput -30% on runtime nodes in eu-west-1 between 2026-03-15T10:12Z and 10:45Z. Spike correlates with tenant acct-327 sending a flood of interactive sessions. Flame/profile shows switch to atten_fused_v2 kernel and KV cache churn.

Jamal Ortiz: any deploys/rollouts around that time?

Maya Chen: no infra deploys. Canary of kernel-selection heuristics rolled 03/12. Attaching flame snippet and kernel heatmap: https://perf.redwood/heatmaps/1799907777 (private link)

Maya Chen: ```
flame: https://perf.redwood/fg/1799907777
heatmap rows:
  kernel:atten_fused_opt (norm) -> 18% time
  kernel:atten_fused_v2 -> 62% time (during spike)
  kv_cache: evict_rate=4.2/s -> baseline 0.2/s
```

Kevin Patel: hm looks like heuristic misclassifying avg_seq_len. If seq_len distribution has a heavy tail (many short + a few 800-1200 prompts) batching chooses medium-seq kernels causing warp divergence. Also tool-loop is hammering with repeated toolcalls: tool.exec count spiked x8 for acct-327.

Sophie Laurent: logs show client reconnects and streaming backpressure: "ERR_WRITE_TIMEOUT backpressure" on streaming worker. That would cascade to scheduler and increase per-request latency. Posted sample logs.

Sophie Laurent: ```
[stream-worker-13] 10:20:12 ERROR write: timeout after 3000ms, client_id=acct-327 sess=xyz
[worker-13] 10:20:13 WARN queue: inflight=256 -> throttle
```

Jamal Ortiz: can we repro locally with a simulated workload? Suggest seq mix: 90% short (40-200), 10% very long (800-1200) plus a small tool-loop pattern to emulate repeated tool.exec.

Kevin Patel: I'm going to pin kernel selection to atten_fused_opt for the affected pool and temporarily disable the new heuristic for 30m. Will also add extra kvcache telemetry tags to trace evictions by tenant. @Sophie can you roll the pin?

Sophie Laurent: On it. Pinning pool eu-west-1/gpu-cpu-pool-7 -> kernel=atten_fused_opt. Rolling now, ETA ~4m. :lock:

Infra-bot: deployment rollback started by Sophie Laurent. Rollout id=roll-2026-03-15-0822

Maya Chen: after pin, p95 dropped to ~240ms and throughput normalized. Repro confirmed locally with the seq-mix and tool-loop pattern. We should add a regression test for seq_length-mix and update the kernel selection cost model to include a backpressure penalty.

Maya Chen: Issue created: PERF-5123 kernel-select: adjust cost model + KV evict telemetry + add seq-mix e2e. Link: https://tracker.redwood/perf/5123
